title: New criteria for upper bounds on the number of limit cycles in Liénard systems
summary: We study upper bounds for isolated periodic orbits of generalized Liénard systems on a single potential well. Common-curvature and common-intercept conditions yield uniqueness and hyperbolicity, while a convex--concave condition on the potential-profile slopes gives an upper bound of two. The statements allow finite unequal potential endpoints; appropriate versions also admit degenerate restoring forces and reduced regularity.
